import sys, json, time, subprocess

def timed(label, raw):
    t=time.time()
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','/workspace/project/main.py'],input=raw,capture_output=True)
    dt=time.time()-t
    try:
        out=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
    except Exception:
        out={'raw':p.stdout[:200].decode('utf8','replace'),'err':p.stderr.decode()[:800]}
    if isinstance(out,dict) and 'channels' in out:
        summary={'chan':[{'n':c['bytes']['n'],'reqs':len(c['requests']),'err':c['error']} for c in out['channels']],
                 'cases':[{'state':c['state'],'at':c['at'],'n':c['sent']['n']} for c in out['cases']]}
    else:
        summary=out
    print('%-30s %6.2fs rc=%d %s' % (label, dt, p.returncode, json.dumps(summary)[:260]))
    return out

def doc(**kw):
    d={"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":10,"cases":[],"events":[],"channels":[]}
    d.update(kw); return json.dumps(d).encode()

case_a=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"headers","data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"]],"End_Stream":True}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/x","host":"h.example"}}]

# huge length body, separate parts
d = doc(definitions=[["BIG", "b'x'*1000000000"]], cases=case_a,
        channels=[{"name":"c","parts":[{"case":"a","data":"GET /x HTTP/1.1\r\nContent-Length: 1000000000\r\n\r\n"},{"case":"a","data":"{{BIG}}"}]}])
timed('huge length body', d)

# huge chunked body
d = doc(definitions=[["BIG", "b'x'*1000000000"]], cases=case_a,
        channels=[{"name":"c","parts":[{"case":"a","data":"POST /x HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.example\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n\r\nfffffffffffffff\r\n"},{"case":"a","data":"{{BIG}}"},{"case":"a","data":"\r\n0\r\n\r\n"}]}])
timed('huge chunked body', d)

# 20000 requests in 20 parts
req = "GET /x HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.example\r\n\r\n"
parts=[{"case":"a","data":req*1000} for _ in range(20)]
d = doc(cases=case_a, channels=[{"name":"c","parts":parts}])
timed('20000 requests', d)

# 40000 chunk lines in 20 parts
chunk = "1\r\na\r\n"
body = chunk*2000
parts=[{"case":"a","data":body} for _ in range(20)]
parts.append({"case":"a","data":"0\r\n\r\n"})
d = doc(cases=case_a, channels=[{"name":"c","parts":[{"case":"a","data":"POST /x HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.example\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n"}]+parts}])
timed('40000 chunk lines', d)

# 50000 frames (no header pairs beyond limit)
frames=[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"x","End_Stream":False} for _ in range(49999)]
d = doc(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":frames,"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}])
timed('49999 frames', d)

# 32768 header pairs
frames=[{"Type":"headers","headers_kv":{"a":"b","c":"d","e":"f","g":"h"},"End_Stream":False} for _ in range(8192)]
d = doc(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":frames,"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}])
timed('32768 header pairs', d)

# 256 channels
chs=[{"name":"c%d"%i,"parts":[{"case":None,"data":"GET /x HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\n\r\n"}]} for i in range(256)]
d = doc(cases=case_a, channels=chs)
timed('256 channels', d)
PYEOF
python3 stress2.py
